note: The one width-2 polyomino whose rectangle-tiling status Dahlke's Gun Theorem leaves unresolved. Tulleken lists it as Problem 52.

rectifiable.note: Dahlke reports testing rectangles up to width 85 without finding a tiling or a proof of untilability. The fe70 project has since ruled out, by exact search, every rectangle with a side of at most 174; see fe70.org for the live search frontier.

order.note: Any rectangle fe70 tiles needs at least 3360 copies; the piece may not tile any rectangle.

tilesHalfStrip.reason: The half-strip of width 88 tiles: an explicit eventually periodic tiling (a 110-row start, then a 10-row block of 88 copies repeating forever), checked independently by exact cover. Width 96 tiles too; every width up to 87 is ruled out by exact search, so 88 is the narrowest.
tilesHalfStrip.note: The tiling grown from the closed end never reaches a flat edge, which is why no rectangle of width 88 exists.
